payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased using negative feedback from utterances with negative responses.

claims.text: Confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased by leveraging utterances with negative system responses, specifically when these domains are among the top-ranked predictions.
The approach formulates a loss function that demotes the confidences of the highest-ranked negative ground-truth domains to avoid overwhelming influence during training.
